thread:
kai: FYI onboarding sylph13b (13B) on staging int4 run. Quick summary: int4 quant + our projorder reorder causes embed vectors to rotate per head, downstream perf drops ~6% on openqa.

linh: logs?

kai: pasted repro below. this is from a single-batch forward with same seed.
```python
# minimal repro
emb_fp16 = model_fp16.embed(inputs)
emb_int4  = model_int4.embed(inputs)
# compute pairwise cos sim
```
FP16 cos sim avg 0.997, INT4 0.92

olivia: Interesting. did you check proj weight layout? gemma/mistral sometimes differ proj order (out_proj vs q/k/v order).

kai: Yeah I diffed tensor shapes, but the params looked same dims. I suspect headwise projorder vs fused proj layout. Also rotary freq application looks shifted by head offset.

mike: @kai can you run with --dump-embed-order and attach first 8 dims? maybe a byte order mismatch.

kai: attaching small snippet (trimmed):
[0.123, 0.045, -0.001, 0.87, 0.002, -0.12, 0.009, -0.33]
Also noticed tokenizer mapping: token id 1 maps to different sentinel in our converter for sylph. Could be token shift causing kv cache misalign.

linh: :eyes: if tokenizer changed, that would shift positional alignment. But mismatch in embed rotation seems orthogonal.

dev-bot: deploy: sylph13b-int4 staged -> onboarder triggered test-suite, EVAL_FAILURES=3

olivia: I ran quick cross-check: apply same quantization code on gemma13b, no rotation. So model architecture likely uses per-head rotary scaling or different rotary basis ordering.

sara: Could it be the 'proj_order' flag in loader? we have a loader flag 'proj_order=per_head' in some converters.

kai: Confirmed: converter for sylph exports q,k,v as contiguous per-head block rather than contiguous per-proj. Our loader expected fused layout -> kvcache indexing reversed. Fixing converter to match our proj_order gives INT4 cos sim 0.995. Will patch.

mike: Nice. Can you add a unit test to catch projorder mismatch during conversion? e.g., compare fp32->quant embed cosine > 0.99 on small sample.

kai: On it. Also filing a short runbook for triage and a follow-up PR to add a quick sanity check in onboarding pipeline (tokenizer mapping, proj_order, rotary-basis).

olivia: :thumbsup: add note about rotary basis ordering and tokenizer mapping to the model manifest so Dedicated/Private loaders use same flags.

kai: thanks all. I'll post PR + CI link when ready.
